question: What complete two-sum sets and component costs does the native Vieta coset extractor produce across field width and coset size, versus matched scalar and batched lookup?

claims.text: Successful arms return identical complete ordered relation sets on each frozen target.
Report descriptive component costs by configuration and population, including all failures and cold setup; no directional or fastest-backend claim.
No last-fall-degree bound, exponent fit, fastest-native-backend or end-to-end ECDLP speedup is established.

arms.description: Simultaneous-inversion subtraction and prepared membership set.
Scalar group subtraction with complete membership lookup.
Composed quadratic remainder, gcd and separate discriminant branch.
Identical batched lookup repeated under a second label.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Each arm receives five independently named conditioned-two-sum target calls per configuration. Every such target must return a nonempty set, with complete equality to lookup; these input-level controls use every arm rather than a separate arm.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Random x conditioned on rational lift is a separate population, not assumed unsatisfiable. Complete lookup determines zero/nonzero output. No null-probability or absence claim is made.

factors.name: field_and_m
factors.how: All 20 configurations are retained separately; no pooled speed or exponent fit.

factors.name: target_population
factors.how: Five retained target calls of each population per configuration; same target across arms.

factors.name: binary_flags_threads
factors.value: one release binary, locked dependencies, one thread
factors.how: Record compiler, source and binary hashes before execution; same binary and primitive counters for all arms.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: Interleave per target so first/last arm cost is balanced; two distinct warmups per configuration.

factors.name: host_environment
factors.how: Record CPU, frequency, SMT, NUMA, kernel, virtualization, co-tenants, PSI, affinity, memory, interruptions and actual admission. No clock interpretation below required tier.

factors.name: layout_hashing
factors.how: HashSet iteration never decides search order. Hashing/allocation/sorting are unpriced by field counters and remain in secondary clock intervals.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: No significance test or directional declaration; retain all status classes and separate populations.

seed_derivation.note: native/main.rs fixes the fixture seed to 0x76696574612d7631 XOR m, uses SplitMix64 words via Arithmetic::random_element, alternating random rational targets and fixed base-index sums. Root seed is the post-fixture seed XOR call index. Freeze exact source before data.

instance_sampling.rule: 20 field/coset configurations, each with two warmups then ten matched target calls, half per population. Random x is reduced modulo p, rejection on nonsquare RHS, canonical Tonelli sign; not uniform points.

blinding.how: Descriptive tables only, unblinded method labels; no inferential decision.

power.note: Not powered for a statistical hypothesis. Ten target calls per configuration give five descriptive observations per population. No significance or general scaling exponent claim is licensed.

primary.name: Primitive multiplications
primary.definition: All multiplications inside each independent stage, including inverse/sqrt internals; cold accounting includes declared reusable setup.

primary.name: Complete ordered relations
primary.definition: Length and SHA-256 of sorted complete pair set, compared across arms and replayed by wide scalar subtraction.

secondary.name: Stage wall interval
secondary.definition: First to last stage operation, fixture generation excluded; include cold setup separately. Do not interpret without admitted host/A-A receipts.
secondary.resolution: monotonic Instant, actual host resolution recorded

stopping_rules.rule: 20 configurations x 4 arms x (2 warmups +10 retained target calls) =960 query rows plus setup. Stop at 3600-second absolute deadline; preserve missing rows and failures.
A set mismatch terminates that configuration as invalid. Budget failure preserves remaining control arms and yields nonzero status. No extra attempts.

decision_rule.text: Descriptive component tables only after complete set equality, successful replay and host/A-A admission. Missing rows or failed admission remain explicitly inconclusive; no directional speed claim.
decision_rule.statistic: per-population median and quartiles; no pooling across configurations
decision_rule.interval: empirical interquartile range, not a confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: matched component costs at declared cold/warm scope; no exponent fit

inadmissible: Launch before checkpoint, live budget/capacity and source/image gates
Represent a fixture ecbench job as this component study
Silently reduce m, fields, target counts or controls
Treat development tests as scale timings
Pool identity and finite-target costs or the two target populations
Count inverse/sqrt calls twice on top of nested primitive totals
Declare fastest backend without the repository Montgomery/external comparison
Promote unsigned producer observations to verified claims

literature.verified_by: producer source read; no signed PCC verdict

literature.claim: Existing decomposition, batch lookup and native arithmetic controls.
